stem: Why is a nasal button battery treated as a true urgency?

options.text: It can cause septal perforation in hours
It converts the nasopharynx into the oropharynx
It prevents use of a light source

explanation: Septal perforation in hours is the key reason a nasal button battery requires urgent removal because it can rapidly damage nasal tissue.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes

optionExplanations.A: Correct because button batteries can cause caustic injury and septal perforation within hours, so urgent removal is required.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because viral pharyngitis is an infection and is not caused by a button battery lodged in the nose.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because the nasopharynx and oropharynx are anatomical regions, and this does not describe a recognised complication.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because Brodsky grade describes tonsil size and is unrelated to nasal button battery injury.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because a light source is used for examination, but it is not the reason the battery is a true urgency.
